text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, the sum of two hundred and fifty thousand pesos, to be disbursed under the direction of the
Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources to carry out the purposes of Act Numbered Twenty-five
hundred and forty-eight, entitled "An Act to provide for the immunization of cattle and carabaos to prevent the
spread of rinderpest within the Philippine Islands, appropriating funds therefor, and for other purposes."

The funds herein appropriated shall be ex- i pended only for salaries of the technical personnel,
traveling expenses, acquisition of instruments and medicines required for the immunization, purchase of
animals for obtaining virulent blood, and for aid to the "insurance fund" of provinces in which immunizing
stations are established: Provided, That contracts with the technical personnel employed for the purpose shall
not be made for a period of more than one year and said personnel shall receive salaries not in excess of those
hereinafter stated:
One veterinarian, class three ....................................
Two veterinarians, class four ...................................
9,000.00
Four veterinarians, class five ...................................
16,000.00
Four veterinarians, class six ....................................
14,400.00
Two veterinarians, class seven ................................
6,400.00
One employee, Class .............................................
960.00
One employee, Class .............................................
600.00
Provided, further, That whenever the necessities of the, service require it and there remains an unexpended
balance of the funds appropriated by this Act, the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources may extend

the contract period until such funds shall have been totally disbursed.

The Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources shall submit a detailed report of the
disbursements made under this Act to the Philippine Legislature before October thirtieth of each year, unless
the funds herein appropriated shall be entirely disbursed, in which case he shall submit a final report of the
disbursements made as well as the results obtained.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 9, 1917.
